sentences.text:
Case :- Writ - C No. - 24919 of 2019
Petitioner :- Jai Maa Ambey Udyog

Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Sanjeev Kumar,Vishal Agarwal
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Pankaj Mithal,J.
Hon'ble Saral Srivastava,J.
Heard Sri Vishal Agarwal, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Standing Counsel.

The petitioner has preferred this petition for the quashing of the recovery citation dated 26.12.2018
for a sum of Rs. 1,55,000/-.
The aforesaid recovery citation has been issued so as to recover the amount pursuant to the order dated 11.10.2018 passed by the competent authority under Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
The petitioner has not challenged the aforesaid order.
The aforesaid order is appealable and since the impugned recovery citation is consequent to the above order, the petitioner is not entitled to any relief unless the main order is challenged by him.
